import z3

# Social Golfers: 21 golfers, 5 weeks, 7 groups of 3
# No pair in same group more than once

num_golfers = 21
num_weeks = 5
num_groups = 7
group_size = 3

s = z3.Solver()

# x[w][p] = group of golfer p in week w
x = [[z3.Int(f"x_{w}_{p}") for p in range(num_golfers)] for w in range(num_weeks)]

# Domain constraints: each golfer in a valid group
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for p in range(num_golfers):
        s.add(x[w][p] >= 0)
        s.add(x[w][p] < num_groups)

# Group size constraints: each group has exactly 3 golfers each week
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for g in range(num_groups):
        s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(x[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(num_golfers)]) == group_size)

# Pair constraint: no pair in same group more than once
# For each pair of golfers, for each pair of weeks, they can't be together in both weeks
for p1 in range(num_golfers):
    for p2 in range(p1 + 1, num_golfers):
        for w1 in range(num_weeks):
            for w2 in range(w1 + 1, num_weeks):
                s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(x[w1][p1] == x[w1][p2], x[w2][p1] == x[w2][p2])))

print("Constraints added. Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = s.check()
elapsed = time.time() - start
print(f"Result: {result} (took {elapsed:.2f}s)")
